ablation: Zero one entire block after frozen signed-log and train-only channel standardization, during both training and validation. Keep 398 inputs, all 109634 trainable parameters, identical initial weights and the valid-line mask.
reference: Reuse the already verified complete fmt_v5 seed96611; five new ablation trainings only. No new feature encoding or data sampling.
ranking: Descending full-validation F1 minus ablated-validation F1, fixed probability threshold 0.5. Also report average precision and each flow separately.
scope: Fast one-seed leave-one-block-out retraining diagnostic on all 27000 training and 3000 validation bundles. No test feature loading or test inference; no channel-level or universal importance claim.
